analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 69.1 enters overbought territory, attempting to break the 5-day high of $34.70. However, trading volume ratio of 0.79 indicates insufficient buying pressure. ADX at 30.9 shows a clear trend, but it has decreased from 32.1 five days ago, suggesting weakening trend strength. Resistance is expected near the 52-week high of $35.31. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted.
